name: Phantasmal Nocturne
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Fischl.
Summon Oz.
While Oz is on the field, your Electro-Related Reactions deals +1 DMG. (3 times per Round)
(You must have Fischl in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
